evidence.reason: The dry-run branch returns at lines 1241–1243 before the recovery conflict check at lines 1245–1247. Because that check explicitly treats --triage-dry-run together with --recover-job as a usage refusal (exit 2), the early return makes the intended validation unreachable and instead exits 0 after triage. Moving the conflict validation before the dry-run branch fixes this without changing a standalone dry run.
